title: Joining Manuel Perez's Imperial Band and relief work
summary: His next band was Perez's Imperial Band with Buddy Johnson, Picou, Baptiste and Jimmy Brown; first job at Lincoln Park, doing relief work since he had no drums yet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Then you... When did you... What was the next band you said you went with?
The next band I went with was Manuel Perez. They had a band named the Imperial Band.
Oh, yes. Yeah. Do you remember who else was in that band with Manuel?

In that band was Buddy Johnson trombone player. Manny Perez cornet player. They used the word trumpet at that time. Yeah. Cornet player. Mm-hmm. And... Alphonse Picou was playing clarinet. Oh, yeah. And Rene Baptiste was playing ghetto. Jimmy Brown playing bass. Mm-hmm. Played my first job with them up at the Lincoln Park.
Oh, yes. How old were you then? About still a little boy?

Yeah, I was a boy then. Mm-hmm. Well, quite naturally, just like I told you. You see, they would take up time with me because I was producing stuff that all the fellas wasn't producing then. You understand what I mean? Yeah. And then musicians were skates.
See, now, when I was playing with those fellas, as I first told you, when I started playing with them, I was doing relief work.
See, because my mother hadn't bought me no drums yet. See? Yeah. They didn't know what I was going to do. Mm-hmm. And in other words, they wasn't able to buy me no drums.
